module_name: Education Access E-Learning Academy — Form One Mathematics
subject: Mathematics

controlling_reference.document: Mathematics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I–IV
controlling_reference.authority_rule: Where Academy materials differ from the prescribed Form One syllabus, the TIE syllabus takes precedence.

instructional_sequence.label: Discover
instructional_sequence.purpose: Activate prior knowledge, introduce the context and identify initial understanding.

instructional_sequence.label: Learn
instructional_sequence.purpose: Develop mathematical concepts through explicit instruction, explanations and worked examples.

instructional_sequence.label: Practise
instructional_sequence.purpose: Build fluency through scaffolded and independent mathematical exercises.

instructional_sequence.label: Knowledge Check
instructional_sequence.purpose: Provide formative checks, feedback and opportunities to address misconceptions.

instructional_sequence.label: Apply
instructional_sequence.purpose: Transfer mathematical knowledge to practical, contextualised problems.

instructional_sequence.label: Voice
instructional_sequence.purpose: Capture oral explanations of methods, reasoning and mathematical vocabulary.

instructional_sequence.label: Journal
instructional_sequence.purpose: Support learner reflection, self-assessment and metacognitive development.

instructional_sequence.label: Friday Assessment
instructional_sequence.purpose: Conduct a weekly assessment aligned with the taught outcomes and assessment criteria.

instructional_sequence.label: Evidence & Mastery
instructional_sequence.purpose: Review learner work and assessment evidence against explicit criteria before recording progression.

curriculum_structure.note: The 35-week figure is an indicative planning calculation from the TIE period allocation. The Academy term calendar and school timetable must be confirmed before publishing a dated scheme of work.

technical_contract.integration_method: A controlled loader or import point will be added to the host platform only after module validation.
data_validation: Every weekly unit must reference at least one TIE content block.
Every learning outcome must be traceable to the TIE syllabus map.
Every assessment item must identify the outcome or outcomes it assesses.
Marking schemes must state expected answers and allocation of marks.
Mastery decisions must be supported by recorded evidence and defined criteria.
No Form II–IV content may be labelled as Form I syllabus content.

learner_data_policy.learner_identity: Read from the host Academy learner profile; do not hard-code a learner name.
learner_data_policy.school_identity: Read from configurable institution settings; do not hard-code a school name.
learner_data_policy.parent_or_guardian_identity: Read from configurable profile data where authorised; do not hard-code names.

versioning_policy.major: Breaking changes to the module data contract or integration interface.
versioning_policy.minor: New units, resources, assessments or backward-compatible functionality.

current_files.purpose: Machine-readable map of Form One TIE content blocks, competences, requirements, methods, resources and assessment criteria.
Module identity, structure, file conventions, technical contract and governance rules.
